with_skill.meaning: current repository Skill with Python domain and sprint-learning

without_skill.meaning: old Skill snapshot, NOT a no-Skill run
without_skill.reproduce_source: baseline commit skills/knowledge-interviewer/SKILL.md, references, scripts and templates

snapshot_handling: Temporary old-copy directory removed after all executions and grading completed; reproduce from baseline_commit and recorded SHA256. No original Skill or learner record was deleted.
state_scope: synthetic read-only; no actual learner records or state writes
timing_source: host completion notifications; total_tokens records host-reported subagent_tokens, not validated billable/output token counts
limitations: One sampled turn per case/configuration, not repeated-run stability measurement.
Execution and independent grading use the same agent family; no human review yet.
The old version lacks Python package and handbook access; comparison measures combined routing/resource/workflow improvement, not isolated wording.
The privacy case tests a read-only refusal to save; successful private writes are covered separately by deterministic state tests.
public_reads contains executor-reported relative paths/ranges, checked against public files; it is not a full independently audited tool transcript.
